featured_reviews.name: Rupert Fernandis
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had earlier booked the banquet for my roce ceremony, also known as haldi. The entire process, from booking to the final payment, was seamless. Based on that positive experience, I decided to book the same place for my wife’s baby shower. Unfortunately, this time it was a nightmare.

They wouldn’t answer calls, and I struggled to get hold of the contact person for the booking. The management had changed, which should have been a warning sign. The booking ended up at a completely different location. I had booked the upper hall for our small crowd, as the lower hall seemed crowded. To my surprise, when I arrived for the event, they had shifted us to the basement without any consent. I didn’t want to spoil the mood at the entrance, so I didn’t say much, but it was unacceptable.

The event was supposed to start at 12:30, but they were still decorating the backdrop when guests began to arrive. They even changed the welcome drinks. I had to coordinate with the staff since the manager was busy with another function in the upper hall. It turns out the halls were switched because the air conditioning near the stage wasn’t working. My wife was sweating a lot due to the peak heat season in Mumbai. They pretended to fix the aircon, but it never worked the entire time.

Then came the issue with the pani puri vendor. He had a cut on his left-hand finger. Despite being told by his manager and me to wear a glove, he refused. I warned my guests, but it’s hard to stop us Indians from enjoying pani puri. Sadly, everyone ate it.

The only saving grace was the food, but the coordination, venue change, and overall management were disastrous. My first experience was amazing, but this time it was a horror show. I hope they improve.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A small but convenient marriage hall located on quite busy SV Road, Mumbai near Jogeshwari West Local station. It has some rooms n roof top open lawn/ banquet of approx. 600 guests capacity. It can be partitioned for separate arrangement of ladies n gents. An impressive wooden stage set like film studios is popular here, but it is too narrow and elevated too much. Overall, the experience did not match the promises made or the price charged. I would strongly advise others to be cautious before booking.

featured_reviews.name: Saleem Sayyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hosted two back-to-back wedding events at this venue, and the experience was disappointing. Despite advance requests, basic facilities like cleanliness and water in washrooms were unavailable on both days. You can compare the washroom facilities with any public toilets available in slums. Cleanliness of entry carpets and chairs also left much to be desired.

The management showed impressive consistency in redirecting responsibility to the caterers for issues that are clearly venue-related. While there are enthusiastic stories about managing extreme situations like unexpected rain, arranging something as simple as an extra power socket proved challenging.

Advance payment is strictly enforced but fails to deliver on basic commitments. Overall, despite the lawn size, the venue is not suitable for more than 100–200 guests, if expectations around basic infrastructure, hygiene and accountability are expected as part of package.

The washroom facilities were pathetic .. looked like temporary tin structures and I chose not to use them, even though I had a long journey ahead after the event.

Overall, a very unpleasant experience. I would never visit or recommend this venue.

Spanish Villa is a hidden gem in Jogeshwari—almost invisible from the outside, but once you step in, it truly feels magical. It’s a budget-friendly banquet hall that works beautifully for weddings and other functions. The team is very flexible and quick to make arrangements according to your timings and requirements.

The ambience becomes incredibly beautiful, and the photos and videos turn out highly cinematic—it genuinely adds a special charm to your memories.

The cost ranges approximately between ₹30,000 to ₹45,000 per hall, depending on your needs. Food arrangements need to be managed separately, as they do not have in-house catering, but overall, it’s an excellent value-for-money venue with a unique vibe.
